obfuscation_indicators: subject to a considerable degree of variability
risk_summary: The disclosure is generally detailed and quantitatively grounded, but relies on forward-looking assumptions regarding Michigan employment, comparable-store sales, inflation, LIFO expense, and claims liabilities. The presentation has a mildly positive tone while acknowledging near-term earnings pressure, operational variability, and substantial estimation uncertainty. Adjusted EBITDA exclusions and unusual-item adjustments may make underlying performance less transparent.
